doc: Opens a .spell AND VALIDATES the timeline (which show_get{file} does not): returns name, fps, duration, how many tracks and which ones were ignored. The `path` argument is the old name of `file` (deprecated, gone next round).
name: load

file.description: Path of the .spell file (the same `file` as show_get, show_save and play_show).

doc: Summary of the open .spell (or of the given file): name, fps, duration, outputs, patch, tracks, cues. full=true returns the whole .spell.
name: show_get

file.description: Path of the .spell to open; empty = the last one opened in this process.

full.description: true = the whole .spell (what the GUI draws) instead of the summary.

doc: Resumes the player paused in this process (the pair of pause).
name: resume

doc: Pauses the player running in this process.
name: pause

doc: Stops the player running in this process.
name: stop

doc: Jumps the player to instant t (seconds).
name: locate

doc: Turns the player loop on or off over the In-Out range of the open show.
name: loop_set

on.description: true turns the loop on, false turns it off.

doc: Fires the next cue (or the one at the given index).
name: cue_go

index.description: Index of the cue; absent = the next one.

doc: Transport state of the running player.
name: transport_state

doc: Delivers an input event to the hooks of the live player (the Graph): key + value.
name: input

doc: Last DMX frame received on the INPUT universe (show.inputs): 512 values.
name: input_get

doc: Clears the open show: new show, sACN on universe 1, 60 s. Returns the whole show.
name: show_new

doc: Replaces the open show with the given JSON (to IMPORT a whole show; to edit, prefer show_patch). Returns the whole show.
name: show_set

data.description: The whole show: JSON object (or JSON text).

doc: Saves the open show (without file, at the path of the last one opened). Returns the path.
name: show_save

file.description: Path of the .spell; empty = the one from the last load/show_get/show_save.

doc: Appends an empty track to the open show (type dmx|artnet|osc|media|cue|fx|laser; clip for laser, script for fx). Returns the index of the track. The `label` argument is the old name of `name` (deprecated, gone next round).
name: track_add

address.description: DMX address 1..512 (osc tracks use text: go through show_set).

name.description: Track name (the .spell `name` field). The `label` argument is the old name of this one (deprecated, gone next round).

type.description: dmx | artnet | osc | media | cue | fx | laser.

doc: Removes the track at the given index. Returns the removed track.
name: track_del

doc: Creates or replaces the keyframe of the track at t. Returns the keyframes of the track.
name: key_set

curve.description: linear | hold | in | out | inout | bezier (curve of the segment that ARRIVES at this keyframe).

doc: Deletes the keyframe of the track at t (1 ms tolerance). Returns how many were removed.
name: key_del

t.description: Instant of the keyframe (1 ms tolerance).

doc: Creates (without index) or replaces a cue: name, fade, wait, follow and DMX values. Returns the index.
name: cue_set

fade.description: Seconds of linear fade to the values.

follow.description: When it ends, it fires the next one.

index.description: Index of the cue to replace; absent = appended at the end.

name.description: Cue name, as it shows in the list.

wait.description: Seconds between the GO and the start of the fade.

doc: Removes the cue at the given index. Returns the removed cue.
name: cue_del

doc: Patches a fixture (profile, universe, address); refuses overlap and running past 512. Returns the patch grid.
name: patch_add

name.description: Unique fixture name in the show.

profile.description: Profile in profiles/ (without .json) or path of a .json.

doc: Removes the fixture from the patch by name. Returns the removed entry.
name: patch_del

doc: Patch grid of the open show (name, profile, universe, address, channels) and the overlap error, if there is one.
name: patch_check

doc: Names of the profiles available in profiles/.
name: profiles

doc: Edits the open show by JSON Patch (RFC 6902: add, remove, replace, test). One failing op cancels them all. Returns {rev, undo}: `undo` is the list of ops that goes back to the previous state, already in application order.
name: show_patch

path.description: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) inside the show: "/fps", "/tracks/-", "/tracks/0/keys/2", "/graph/nodes". The whole document ("") is not a target: show_set is there for that.

value.description: Value of add, replace and test; `remove` does not use it. Absent on the first three = error.

ops.description: The operations, in order; the first one that fails cancels them all.

rev.description: The revision the client held; different from the current one = refused ("rev 3 != 5").

doc: The graph of the open show (PRD section 10: nodes and edges); empty when the show has no graph.
name: graph_get

doc: The face of the open show: the inline object of `face`, or faces/<name>.face.json when `face` is text. null when the show has no face.
name: face_get

doc: The whole profile (name, channels with offset, ranges and wheel) for the client to build the widgets.
name: profile_get

name.description: Profile in profiles/ (without .json) or path of a .json.

doc: Programmer: writes values into the manual override, on top of the timeline (HTP). Requires a running player.
name: level_set

values.description: Values 0..255 from `address` on; an empty list writes zero on the channel.

doc: Releases the programmer override (one universe, or all of them without universe). Returns how many channels were freed.
name: level_clear

doc: Programmer override as {"universe/address": value}.
name: level_get

doc: Stores the programmer override as a new cue at the end of the list and releases the override. Returns the index.
name: cue_capture

fade.description: Seconds of linear fade to the values.

follow.description: When it ends, it fires the next one.

wait.description: Seconds between the GO and the start of the fade.

doc: Writes into a channel of a patched fixture by the channel name in the profile (via level_set).
name: fixture_set

channel.description: Channel name in the profile ("dim", "r"); a number does not resolve.

doc: Loads a module.json (file=) or the manifest (data=), validates it and puts it in the table of live modules; the same name replaces. Returns name and version.
name: module_add

data.description: The whole manifest, when it does not come from a file.

file.description: Name in modules/ (without .json) or path of a .json.

doc: Removes the module from the table by name. Returns the removed manifest.
name: module_del

name.description: Module name (the `name` field of the manifest).

doc: Live modules: name, type and version.
name: module_list

doc: The whole manifest of the loaded module (parameters, values, commands).
name: module_get

name.description: Module name (the `name` field of the manifest).

doc: Arms (or disarms) the recording of a dmx track: with the transport playing, the input universe becomes keyframes.
name: rec_arm

track.description: Index of the track in `tracks` (it has to be `dmx` or `artnet`).

doc: Tracks armed for recording in this process.
name: rec_state

doc: Lists the MIDI input ports of the machine and which one is open.
name: midi_ports

doc: Opens a MIDI input port (name, part of the name or index) and writes midi_port into the open show.
name: midi_open

port.description: Port name (or part of it), index as text ("0"), or empty = the first one.

doc: Closes the MIDI port and removes midi_port from the open show.
name: midi_close

doc: Binds a key/CC to a command in the open show. Returns the map.
name: midi_map

args.description: Arguments of the command. "$" becomes the value 0..1 and "$<n>" becomes round(value * n).

key.description: Event key: "<status>/<data1>" (144/60 = note on note 60, 176/1 = CC 1).

doc: Unbinds a key from the open show.
name: midi_unmap

doc: The key -> command map of the open show.
name: midi_maps

doc: Last MIDI key received: {key, value, raw, seq}. It is what the GUI shows live.
name: midi_last

doc: Waits up to 5 s for the next MIDI key and returns its key.
name: midi_learn

doc: Plays a .spell show to the end or Ctrl+C.
name: play_show

loop.description: Repeats the show from the start when it reaches the end.

osc_port.description: Port of the remote transport over OSC (overrides transport.osc_port of the .spell).

doc: Scans the network: interfaces, Art-Net nodes, sACN sources, Ether Dream and hints.
name: net

json.description: Returns the raw result as JSON instead of the text report.

doc: Compiles the graph of the open show without running it. Returns {nodes, error}.
name: graph_check

doc: Looks for laser DACs: Ether Dream by beacon and IDN by scan.
name: laser_dacs

doc: Opens a laser DAC and returns the feed id. The safety is mandatory and never switches off.
name: laser_open

kpps.description: Thousands of points per second delivered to the DAC.

safety.description: Safety of the feed: {"min_size": 2000, "max_intensity": 255, "zone": [x0,y0,x1,y1]} in ILDA units. Absent = the default. Never switchable off.

doc: Plays a .ild on the feed: it reads the frames and pushes them at fps (the .ild carries no rate).
name: laser_play

fps.description: Frames per second pushed to the DAC (the .ild carries no rate).

loop.description: Restarts from the first frame when it reaches the end.

doc: Stops the playback of the feed; the DAC stays open.
name: laser_stop

doc: Stops and closes the feed (it shuts the DAC down).
name: laser_close

doc: Sets a parameter of the feed: geo/x geo/y geo/scale geo/rot limit/r limit/g limit/b safe/min_size safe/max_intensity shutter.
name: laser_param

path.description: geo/x, geo/y, geo/scale, geo/rot, limit/r, limit/g, limit/b, safe/min_size, safe/max_intensity, shutter.

value.description: Value in the range of the `path` (the range table is in spellcore/README.md).

doc: State of the feed: playing, file, stat/sent, stat/dropped, stat/errors, jitter and cpu.
name: laser_stats

doc: Lists the .ild of a directory (empty = shows/).
name: laser_files

doc: One frame of the .ild to draw: it picks by `index` or by `t` at `fps`, and returns the points [x, y, r, g, b, blank] with x and y normalized to -1..1.
name: clip_frame

clip.description: Path of the .ild, or the name the track uses (it resolves in the open show folder).

fps.description: Frames per second of the track (the .ild carries no rate).

index.description: The frame asked for directly; without it, the frame of `t`.

t.description: Time in seconds; with `fps` it picks the frame. Ignored when `index` comes in.
